short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: One source sends two point five amperes and another sends one point five amperes, in the same direction, through a one ohm resistor. What's the total power? Pause and try it!

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Add the currents first: four amperes. Four squared times one is sixteen watts. Adding the powers separately gives eight point five, which is wrong.
